_comment: Multi-display example: "displays" gives each role its own cards (key = role, board name or id; "default" for the rest). A single display (role "all") keeps showing the top-level "cards".
title: Attack from Mars

cards.title: HOW TO PLAY
cards.text:
Hit the Martian saucer to damage it, then shoot the saucer to destroy it. Each destroyed saucer is a country saved.
Light Martian Attack, Stroke of Luck and Total Annihilation for huge scores.
